newsitem.title: CHINA: China Venturetech says no more bond issues now.
newsitem.headline: China Venturetech says no more bond issues now.

text.p: China Venturetech Investment Corp said on Thursday it planned no further bond issues until a $30 million issue by a Hong Kong subsidiary is complete.
Hong Kong-based China Venturetechno International Co Ltd had launched its issue backed by a Letter of Undertaking from its parent firm, the company said in a statement.
"There are some confusions in the marketplace that another entity relating to China Venturetech is contemplating a debt financing," it said.

"China Venturetech hereby formally declares that no other debt financing will be contemplated nor will any debt financing mandate be awarded by any entities relating to us before the completion of the US$30-million, three-year floating rate note issued by China Venturetechno International Co Ltd," it said.
